AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Vegetables? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Vegetables.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Vegetables.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Vegetables.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Vegetables.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Repai and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Home Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Laundering Cotton Item and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Repairing Garments 11 4.2 Constructing Innovative Gardens 14 Total Number of Les and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Repairing Garments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
